description: Save credential fields on a deployed agent: API keys, bot tokens, account IDs, allow lists, your own OAuth app keys, or the token for a browser-free connection. Call with only credential (no fields) to see that credential's field keys, formats, which are required, how it connects, and what is already set on this agent; nothing is written then. Skip that call when list_agent_skills with name already showed the fields. Then call with fields. Every field is checked before anything is written; unknown or Wiro-managed fields are refused. A key file, such as a Google service account JSON or an App Store .p8 key, takes the file's text, never a link: never ask for a public link to a key (the user can also upload it on the agent's page in the Wiro dashboard). Other file fields take a public URL and the file is uploaded. Values are never echoed back. A running agent restarts to load values that change; a save that changes nothing leaves it running. Channels such as Telegram, Slack and Discord turn on by themselves once all their required fields are set, and turn off when one is cleared. Saving a credential turns on the scheduled tasks that need it, and the result names any that stay paused until a skill they need is on; turn off any you do not want. Sign-in integrations (such as Google Ads, YouTube, Meta and HubSpot) are then connected with connect_agent_oauth; Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive are not sign-ins and are set here. To connect a Wiro project (credential "wiro"), use bind_agent_project first: it takes no key. Only save a Wiro project API key here that the user gave you for this: model runs are billed to the wallet of the workspace that owns the project. On a team agent this needs a team admin or the person who deployed it; other team members can read the agent with get_my_agent and message it, so do not ask them for values they cannot save. The agents playbook (get_playbook) has the full setup walkthrough.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents.

credential.description: Describe mode: a credential key such as "telegram" or "google-ads". Used when fields is empty.

fields.description: Fields to save. Send the fields of one credential together.

field.description: Field key inside that credential, for example "bottoken". Use "authmethod" to pick a connection mode (for example "api_key").

ordinal.description: With parent_field: the entry's position in the list, from 0.

parent_field.description: Only to change one entry of a list field: that list field's key, for example "groups".

value.description: The value. Lists are JSON arrays; a list of objects replaces the whole list. A key file takes the file's text; other files take a public http(s) URL. An empty value clears an optional field. A required field cannot be cleared, except on a chat channel, which then turns off.
